events.title: Fall in Love Festival and NPF Streams All Week!

events.title: August Production Update - All Sprites Complete!
events.summary: Hey all! I just sent ver 0.53 to Patrons, which included the final character sprites, and over a dozen more CGs and art assets. Let's take a quick look at what's new:Thank you so much to everyone who's wishlisted the game so far! We've passed 1,500 wishlists, just in time for the Fall in Love festival next week. Keep an eyes out for folks who'll be streaming the game, and maybe you'll even be hearing from me too!-Royce

events.title: Demo Updated!
events.summary: Hey all! The Demo has been updated to ver 0.48.1, which adds two new CGs and one new sprite. The CGs are viewable in the extras gallery once unlocked.I don't plan on doing frequent updates to the demo; I'm hard at work on the structure edit for NPF and painting final art. But since the demo is the beginning of the game, it seemed silly not to share these with you all.Anyway, hang in there, folks. We're nearly through February. You got this, and I'll see you all later.
